Name: Instinctual Response
Casting Time: Special (when you would take a reaction)
Description: Your senses are sharpened and you can act swiftly. When you have already used your reaction but a reaction would be triggered, you may cast this spell to take an additional reaction and do so. You cannot use this reaction in response to the same trigger as one you reacted to already this turn (such as the same instance of a creature moving out of your reach, or casting a second reaction spell in response to the same attack as another). Sword Saint Bonus. This spell is treated as being on the class spell list(s) of any creature who has at least three levels in sword saint.
